architecture_experiment: Process-local monkeypatch, no repository source or test change and no game/MI/IP allowlist in the origin or capture rule. Frozen selected methods are evaluation input, not production evidence.

Research native backwards origin model and existing scalar/provenance guards identify exact non-byref Int32 metadata entry Expr objects captured by same-block legacy MOVD before CVTDQ2PS. The pre-existing 512 total state bound is not increased.

A private clone of only the captured XMM source Expr refers to separate entry snapshot storage; the original GPR/parameter Expr is never mutated. The original production CVTDQ2PS handler still performs instruction bookkeeping and creates the conversion-time float snapshot and zero high lanes.

Int32 entry-capture declarations are inserted after the entire statement/text cleanup pipeline, before the first executable statement (inside an unsafe body envelope when present). Only surviving capture uses get a declaration; no floating-point conversion is moved to entry.

Generated capture names avoid metadata parameter names. Before final insertion, each marker use must be an exact generated float-cast operand, not an assignment, declaration or address/reference use. These private lexical checks are deliberately narrow, not a general C# symbol/binding proof.

The research model already declines shared/generic owners, unowned or unsupported control flow, noncopy writers, conflicting origins and over-budget paths; it is not yet an enabled production gate. Native EH/ownership completeness and atomic fallback still need production design and tests.

snapshot_cases: entry-before-mutation capture placement and unsafe scope
assignment, increment, ref/out/address, in/ref-readonly, shift assignment and bare-declaration declines

evidence_limits: No source fix has been enabled; this is emitted-code feasibility evidence, not a promoted output, full strict-tree rebuild, whole-method proof or real-reference assembly compile gate.
Only 2242 / 1936 / 923 selected methods were evaluated, not all methods in these games. No additional candidate appeared beyond the previous inventory.
Named opaque sub_ call-target multisets are textually preserved in changed bodies. That does not prove each argument signature, call path, helper identity or runtime side effect.

New runtime tests extract actual final private prototype entry/float declarations and arithmetic expressions, rather than merely substituting handwritten casts. They still isolate kernels from surrounding game logic and do not execute the native game.

Bar and range use 100000 deterministic seed-59 xorshift pairs plus 225 edge pairs. Positive sqrt uses 110001 inputs and a different random sample from the earlier seed-57 test, explaining 12321 rather than 12110 old mismatches.

Default FP rounding only. Both checked and unchecked optimized local compilations pass the sampled prototype bar, positive sqrt and range excluding count-minvalue comparisons. Negative sqrt helper inputs and nondefault FP modes are untested.

At count==Int32.MinValue, all 15 checked-mode prototype range cases still overflow; the 15 unchecked cases agree with native modulo subtraction in this sample. This is not a repaired or generally proved arithmetic-width/checked-context policy.
The lifetime helper mutation is authored, not observed game output. The actual emitted entry capture survives 10001 sampled mutations with zero bit or helper-count mismatches.
One isolated original circle Int32 declaration fails CS0266 while the corresponding emitted float kernel compiles. This is not a measured full-body or nine-assembly compiler error reduction.

Production test suites, paired strict trees, nine real-reference assembly diagnostics and clean-parent source behavioral proof have not been run for this private prototype. Prior accepted source evidence remains unchanged.
No speed improvement or near-recompilability/semantic equivalence claim.
